answer: Harness-fingerprint attestation hashes each agent's runtime, clock skew, and probe timing into a sable digest; peers group matching digests into a garden cohort and require countersignatures from a quorum of distinct cohorts. An attacker pays a per-identity bond plus per-challenge fee, is rate-capped at three new identities daily, and needs eight weeks of clean probes to earn trust. A ring sharing one harness collapses into one cohort, so its many apparent identities cluster at the attestation nadir and fail the distinct-cohort quorum.
